title: A 360° Version Control and Asset Management Workflow - Now with ArtStash
summary: Manage, find, and organize every creative asset in seconds - discover how Diversion + ArtStash deliver the ultimate 360° workflow for game devs and creative teams.
body_text: At Diversion, we believe creative teams deserve tools that move at the speed of ideas. Versioning shouldn’t slow momentum, and managing assets shouldn’t block creativity. That’s why we’re excited to announce a new step forward in the Diversion ecosystem: an integration with ArtStash , a modern Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform built for creators, game developers, and real-time production teams. This collaboration brings a complete workflow experience to Diversion users: ✅ Reliable version control ✅ Visual asset organization ✅ AI-powered search and asset grouping ✅ Seamless creative pipeline management And even better: ArtStash is free for one year for all Diversion users. Sign up here. ‍ Why we teamed up with ArtStash Diversion empowers teams to version large creative projects with confidence - branches, reviews, Unreal Engine workflows, cloud-native performance, and more. ArtStash adds a visual layer on top of your Diversion repositories, making it faster than ever to browse, locate, and manage large asset libraries. Now, your assets don’t just live inside repositories - you can explore them visually, organize them by meaning, and find exactly what you’re looking for in seconds. Together, Diversion + ArtStash deliver a 360° workflow built for creative production. ‍ What the integration enables See all your assets at a glance ArtStash automatically pulls assets from your Diversion repositories and displays them in a clean, visual layout. No digging through folders or guessing file paths - you’ll instantly see textures, meshes, animations, materials, audio files, and more in a browsable gallery. ‍ Organize with meaningful tags (not just folder names) Structure your assets your way. Apply custom tags to organize by workflow, sprint, game feature, biome, character, level, or asset type. Example tag structures: Character > Boss > Frost Giant Environment > Desert > Rocks UI > Inventory Icons Animation > Walk Cycle > Orc This makes it easier for artists, designers, and developers to navigate large repositories together. ‍ AI-powered auto-tagging & discovery This is where it gets exciting: ArtStash uses AI to analyze your assets visually and generate relevant auto-tags. It can even detect similar assets across different repositories and intelligently group them. So even if someone uploads mesh_final_v6_really_final.fbx, you can still find it by searching “character armor” or “NPC human male” - because ArtStash recognizes the content, not just the file name. ‍ Built for how teams actually work Want better ways to search than just by filename? With ArtStash integration, you can search: ✔ By keywords ✔ By visual similarity ✔ By tags and tag groups ✔ By AI-generated descriptions This dramatically improves team productivity and creative reuse, especially in large game projects where thousands of assets evolve over time. It’s a natural evolution - a version control system and an asset management system working together for teams who build visually. ‍ Who benefits from this integration? If your pipeline includes digital assets - you’ll feel the impact immediately. ‍ Get started in minutes Connecting ArtStash to Diversion is simple: sign in to ArtStash, connect your Diversion account, and sync your repositories. That’s it. Learn how to connect ArtStash to your Diversion account here. ‍ A stronger ecosystem for creators This collaboration is part of our ongoing mission to build a toolchain that truly supports creative production at scale. Diversion gives teams control. ArtStash adds clarity. Together- they unlock a faster, smarter workflow designed for teams that build worlds. And this is just the beginning - more ecosystem integrations are coming soon. ‍

title: Strengthening Financial Industry Network Resilience with Out-of-Band Management
summary: Lantronix | Strengthening Financial Industry Network Resilience with Out-of-Band Management
body_text: October 27, 2025 General Strengthening Financial Industry Network Resilience with Out-of-Band Management Enabling Secure Operations Across Data Centers and Branch Offices Financial institutions depend on reliable, secure network connectivity to process transactions, deliver digital services, and safeguard sensitive data. With increasingly distributed IT infrastructures and rising cyber threats, maintaining visibility and control across all sites — especially during outages or security incidents — is a top operational priority. Out-of-Band (OOB) management provides a dedicated, independent pathway for network visibility and control when the production network is unavailable. For over 20 years, banks, credit unions, and financial service providers, Lantronix OOB management solutions deliver enhanced uptime, faster incident recovery, and stronger cybersecurity defenses across data centers, branches, and remote offices. Isolated Management for Stronger Cybersecurity Managing your network through the same data plane used for business traffic introduces unnecessary risk. If attackers compromise the production network, they may also gain access to critical infrastructure management interfaces. Lantronix OOB solutions reduce this risk through an Isolated Management Infrastructure (IMI) that separates management traffic from operational traffic: Physical Separation | Following guidance from the NSA and CISA, Lantronix connects directly to console ports on routers, switches, and firewalls, ensuring true physical segmentation of management access. Reduced Attack Surface | Isolation prevents threats that affect the production network from reaching the management plane. Hardened Management Path | The Lantronix LM-Series console servers run a locked-down Linux OS, preventing unauthorized software installation and protecting stored credentials, keys, and secrets. This architecture strengthens your cybersecurity posture by preventing lateral movement and protecting the management plane — the foundation of network control. Secure Access and Granular Control For financial networks, enforcing strict access control is essential for compliance and risk mitigation. Lantronix OOB solutions provide advanced security controls that protect against insider threats and credential abuse: Encrypted Management Sessions | All traffic is encrypted end-to-end, using Reverse SSH and IPsec tunnels. FIPS 140-2 Validated Cryptography | Lantronix solutions meet federal standards for cryptographic security. Centralized AAA Integration | Full compatibility with TACACS, RADIUS, and LDAP enables centralized Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA), with support for multi-factor authentication (MFA). Command-Level Authorization | Administrators can define granular permissions for each user, down to port- and command-level access — reducing operational risk and improving compliance visibility. Faster Network Recovery and Automated Operations Out-of-Band management is more than a backup plan — it’s a cornerstone of financial network resilience. When outages or incidents occur, Lantronix OOB solutions keep your IT teams connected to critical devices, enabling faster diagnosis and recovery. Resilient Access During Outages | Maintain secure management access to remote infrastructure even during ransomware events or major network disruptions and serving as an Isolated Recovery Environment (IRE) with config and OS backups stored locally on the console server and backed up in the Lantronix Control Center. AI-Driven Automated Remediation | The LM-Series integrates rules-based AI to work as an expert system that analyzes console data and can automatically perform pre-approved actions — such as clearing an interface, rebooting a device, or restoring configurations — to minimize downtime. Automatic Rollback and Restore | Features like Surgical Rollback and Bare Metal Restore allow administrators to revert misconfigurations rapidly or replace failed hardware automatically from the last known-good configuration. These capabilities help financial IT teams meet stringent uptime and business continuity requirements with confidence. Continuous Logging and Forensic Visibility Accurate, tamper-proof records are essential for compliance, auditing, and incident response in the financial sector. Lantronix OOB solutions provide complete visibility, even during outages. Comprehensive Session Logging | Every users’ keystrokes, commands, and configuration changes are captured for full accountability. Independent Data Capture | Logs and diagnostic data are collected locally on the LM-Series console server and backed-up in the Control Center, ensuring continuity of evidence even when the primary network is unavailable. Layer 1–3 Monitoring | Continuous state-aware monitoring supports proactive diagnostics and deeper forensic insight into network performance and failures. Trusted by Global Financial Institutions For over 20 years, Lantronix has been a trusted partner to leading global financial institutions, providing secure and resilient management of critical IT networks like the SWIFT network. By isolating management access, enforcing strict authentication, and enabling intelligent automation, Lantronix Out-of-Band management solutions help financial organizations achieve: Greater network uptime and reliability Stronger cybersecurity posture Faster recovery and incident response Improved compliance and operational control Contact Lantronix for a demo where we can show you how Out-of-Band management can strengthen your financial network resilience and simplify secure infrastructure operations.

History has proven that innovation improves the safety of our nation's roadways. Aurora is committed to fulfilling our mission to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. title: Meet Multifactor: Putting Your Digital Life on Autopilot
summary: A closer look at the platform designed to unify and secure your entire digital identity.
body_text: Meet Multifactor: Putting Your Digital Life on Autopilot 2025-10-31 Company Research Agentic VN Vivek Nair Founder & CEO Managing your online life can really be a headache. Even the simple act of logging in has become a fractured experience of ever-changing standards and diverse authentication flows. To get anything done, we integrate apps with one another, creating a complex web of permissions that are tough to track and create even more vulnerabilities. How do you bring all of this together into a single, cohesive, and secure experience? We believe we have the answer. Our product, Multifactor, is engineered from the ground up to solve this problem and a whole lot more. Let’s explore how we’re enabling a new way to manage and experience your digital identity. You can sign up now to get early access! Password Manager on Steroids Password managers were a necessary first step, but they are a simple feature, not the future. While storing complicated passwords is a great start, it has been outpaced by the evolution of the digital world that requires more than just a password to access your accounts. Given that, current products often provide a clunky and outdated user experience and fail to address the other factors of a modern login, with no real innovation in sight. Multifactor is the next step in the evolution: a true Account Manager. It doesn't just store passwords and it's not just for helping you login. Your vault is designed to hold all your authentication factors—passwords, passkeys, TOTP codes, email magic links, OAuth, and more. As you browse, Multifactor puts these at your fingertips, enabling a true one-click login for the dozens of times you need it every single day. At the very least, it's a huge improvement over the password manager you're using today, and we've just scratched the surface. Ready to make the switch? Transitioning is seamless. We've built quick import flows to let you migrate from your old password manager and authenticator apps in seconds. We’ll also support the new Credential Exchange Protocol (CXP) so you can easily transfer your passkeys. No manual entry, no hassle. Apps and extensions will be available on all platforms and browsers so you can bring Multifactor with you wherever you go. True Account Sharing, Without the Secrets Sharing access in legacy password management applications means sharing the entire secret itself. You send a password and/or two-factor authentication code to a colleague, and from that moment on, you’ve lost control. You have no idea if the password been copied, shared with someone else, or stored insecurely. You’re putting your entire trust in this other individual which is not acceptable when you’re sharing accounts with an AI agent. Multifactor introduces a new paradigm. You can share access to an entire account with another person without ever revealing the underlying credentials. If you update your password or change a security factor, they’ll never know the difference—their access simply continues to work. You’ll never have to hear “did you change the password again?” or "can you check your email for the one-time code?" You’ll never need to update everyone’s access to an account if you need to remove one person from a shared group like you would if you share a password directly. This is the foundation of our groundbreaking sharing platform, which makes granting access to any online service as simple and as powerful as sharing a Google Doc. You can grant temporary, one-click access to a human assistant or an AI agent with fine-grained controls: Granular Permissions: Don’t want someone making changes to a sensitive account like a bank? Grant them "read-only" access to view transactions, but not to make transfers. Each of your applications can have its own unique set of rules, allowing you to set precise restrictions from a clean, simple interface. Secure & Revocable: The receiver never sees your secret; they just get secure, revocable access when they need it. When you revoke access, it's gone—instantly. This would even stop them mid-video if they're streaming a movie on your account. This is a fundamental security shift, especially for AI. You cannot safely give credentials directly to AI agents; they can be tricked into exfiltrating secrets, and storing them in a chat context leaves you vulnerable to breaches at the model provider level. Multifactor solves this and opens up a whole new world of possibilities for AI-powered productivity. Your History is the Key to Your Future With Multifactor, the complete history of your accounts is available to you. Every login, every shared access, and every action taken is recorded in each specific account action log. This not only gives you an unprecedented security overview but also creates a foundation for powerful new features built on your own activity. Plus, you'll never lose a credential again since its entire history is at your fingertips. As you work more and more with Multifactor, your actions will be recorded so that you can use your own activity log later to create your own automations. This is why we say that you can "put your accounts on autopilot." However, there is no need to worry about your privacy! Any sensitive data is fully end-to-end encrypted with novel post-quantum techniques developed by our team . Now, with the advent of AI and AI agents in tandem with your own usage of your favorite apps, we can help you put everything together into a single, cohesive experience that simplifies every aspect of your digital life. Agentic Productivity and Your Personal Autopilot To showcase the power of every aspect of this new paradigm, we built our own AI agent, Multi. By granting Multi access through the secure Multifactor platform, you can automate workflows across your different accounts with task-specific permissions, giving you a safe preview of agentic productivity. This is unlike any other AI application you've seen before—this one is built for you, by you. We call these automations "Playbooks." Playbooks are automated workflows that Multi can execute on your behalf. They can be triggered manually or based on any condition you set. To get you started, the Multifactor app will ship with two built-in playbooks focused on keeping you secure and making your accounts easier to use: Password Rotation: Automatically generate and update your accounts with new, strong passwords with a single click. 2FA Upgrade: Scan your accounts and upgrade them to the strongest possible two-factor authentication method available. We all know how tedious and difficult this process is manually which is why no one does it. Now, it’s one click and can be done automatically on a schedule if you want. And this is just the beginning. Soon, you'll be able to build your own Playbooks. Want a custom morning report that pulls data from three different services? Or an instant alert when specific activity occurs in an account? With Multifactor, you can make all of this possible. Check It Out for Yourself! Over the next few months, we will be moving faster than ever to get more features into your hands. Click the "Get Started" button below to give Multifactor a try and experience the future of digital identity management today. We're redefining zero-trust — so you can protect your accounts with confidence. Identity is your first and last line of defense, and the root cause of most application security breaches. Multifactor's provably secure zero-trust solutions cryptographically guarantee that only authorized users can access sensitive data, turning identity into your greatest asset in the fight against cyber threats. Learn more about our research, or reach out to explore working together. Get Started Learn More Related Posts We're Hiring 2026-03-02 Company Research Agentic Multifactor is hiring. If you are a talented engineering leader or individual contributor who cares deeply about forging the future of authentication, authorization, and auditing for the agentic era, you should probably check out our open positions. VN Vivek Nair Founder & CEO Multifactor Versus Password Managers: Securing Capabilities, Not Credentials 2026-01-31 Company Research Agentic Say goodbye to password managers and hello to Multifactor, the world’s first true Account Manager! VN Vivek Nair Founder & CEO Addressing the AAA Threat: AuthN, AuthZ, and Auditing for Agentic Applications 2025-09-08 Company Research Agentic Multifactor’s platform and technology solves the “AAA threat” and enables new capabilities by allowing agentic applications to have secure access to users’ accounts. VN Vivek Nair Founder & CEO

title: Equall Improves Legal Document Structuring and Retrieval Accuracy with ZeroEntropy
summary: ZeroEntropy's reranker consistently outperformed every alternative we tested — recall@10, recall@5, across datasets. It's fast, stable, and a no-brainer for legal document pipelines.
body_text: TL;DR With ZeroEntropy ’s zerank-1 reranker , Equall achieved significantly higher recall and precision in their structured extraction workflows, leading to fewer false negatives and faster verification cycles across thousands of VC and corporate legal documents. Company and Highlights Equall is a frontier AI company building end-to-end systems to solve complex, real-world legal problems. Their products help lawyers and corporations evaluate and manage legal risk through automation and live data analysis. Equall’s flagship platform processes thousands of VC and corporate documents — from certificates of incorporation to board consents — extracting structured information to help EC/VC lawyers verify compliance and detect inconsistencies in real time. With ZeroEntropy ’s zerank-1 reranker , Equall achieved significantly higher recall and precision in their structured extraction workflows, leading to fewer false negatives and faster verification cycles . Domain : Legal document processing Use case : Structured extraction and deep document search Stack : Internal extraction logic + ZeroEntropy reranker Integration : Simple API swap Key metrics : Recall@5 ↑, Recall@10 ↑, latency <100 ms Problem Equall’s system parses hundreds of documents per deal. Those corporate legal documents introduce a uniquely challenging retrieval problem. They tend to be long, multi-part, and interdependent — often combining amendments, exhibits, annexes, and cross-references that evolve across corporate lifecycles. Understanding these relationships and retrieving the right context at the right time is critical: missed or mis-ranked references can lead to incomplete extractions or inconsistent lineage tracking in a domain where accuracy is non-negotiable . Their extraction pipeline needs to: Retrieve the right document segments for each target field (e.g. dates, vesting terms, investors rights etc.. board resolutions, agreement dates). Maintain high recall across complex, domain-specific phrasing. Deliver consistent latency suitable for real-time lawyer workflows. Off-the-shelf vector search or large- embedding -only systems struggled in this context — noisy retrievals, weak calibration , and insufficient context handling. Approach With ZeroEntropy’s zerank-1 reranker, Equall integrated a stronger retrieval layer directly into its existing extraction pipeline. The swap was simple at the API level but delivered immediate gains in both accuracy and efficiency — higher recall and precision, coupled with latency below 100 ms. Because better recall allows for tighter and more relevant context windows, downstream models now operate faster and with greater consistency across complex document sets. They benchmarked the reranker internally using annotated fields from real-world datarooms, evaluating recall@k across multiple extraction types — from simple/generic dates to complex and domain-specific clauses including accelerations, valuation caps, discount rate etc. Implementation was frictionless: Feed existing candidates Existing embedding candidates fed into ZeroEntropy’s API. Rerank top candidates ZeroEntropy reranked the top candidates per field. Minimal code changes Minimal code changes, immediate lift in quality. Sufficient rate limits Rate limits were quite subsequent for our use case. Results Accuracy Consistent recall@5 and recall@10 gains across nearly all document types. Improved contextual understanding in ambiguous cases (e.g., multiple annexes or cross-referenced terms). Outperformed internal baselines and commercial rerankers tested. No tuning needed — the API works out of the box with consistent results. Latency and Stability Metric Value p50 latency 75 ms p90 latency 130 ms p99 latency 240 ms Fully stable in production workloads with gradual rollout across extraction schemas. Product Impact Reduced manual review time for lawyers. Increased trust in automated extraction. Enabled downstream “deep research” features powered by accurate retrieval. Decision Equall is now expanding ZeroEntropy’s use beyond reranking, testing ZeroEntropy newest models and end-to-end search pipelines .

In between the semi-annual rebalance period of the Index, because the Fund is not equally weighted on a continuous basis, the Fund may be exposed to one or more Underlying ETFs disproportionately when compared to other Underlying ETFs. In such circumstances, the Fund will be subject to the over-weighted performance of such Underlying ETF. As a shareholder in other ETFs, the Fund bears its proportionate share of each ETF's expenses, subjecting Fund shareholders to duplicative expenses. There are no assurances the Underlying ETFs will be successful in providing the sought-after protection. The outcomes that the Underlying ETFs seek to provide may only be realized if you are holding shares on the first day of the outcome period and continue to hold them on the last day of the outcome period, approximately one year. There is no guarantee that the outcomes for an outcome period will be realized or that the Underlying ETFs will achieve its investment objective. If the outcome period has begun and the underlying ETF has increased in value, any appreciation of the Fund(s) by virtue of increases in the underlying ETF since the commencement of the outcome period will not be protected by the sought-after protection, and an investor could experience losses until the underlying ETF returns to the original price at the commencement of the outcome period. The Underlying ETFs are subject to an upside return cap (the "Cap") that represents the maximum percentage return an investor can achieve from an investment in the fund(s) for the outcome period, before fees and expenses. If the outcome period has begun and the Underlying ETFs have increased in value to a level near to their individual Cap, an investor purchasing at that price has little or no ability to achieve gains but remains vulnerable to downside risks. Additionally, the Cap may rise or fall from one outcome period to the next. Unlike the Underlying ETFs, the Fund itself does not pursue a target outcome strategy. The protection is only provided by the Underlying ETFs and the Fund itself does not provide any stated downside protection against losses. The Fund will likely not receive the full benefit of the Underlying ETF downside protections and could have limited upside potential. The Fund's returns are limited by the caps of the Underlying ETFs. The Cap, and the Fund(s) position relative to it, should be considered before investing in the Fund(s) website, www.calamos.com , provides important Fund information as well as information relating to the potential outcomes of an investment in the Fund(s) on a daily basis. Cap Rate - Maximum percentage return an investor can achieve from an investment in the Fund if held over the Outcome Period. Protection Level - Amount of protection the Fund is designed to achieve over the Days Remaining. Outcome Period - The defined length of time over which the outcomes are sought. title: NVIDIA GTC DC Takeaways for Biopharma: Sovereign AI, Physical AI, and the Data Work That Pays Off
summary: Takeaways from NVIDIA GTC DC: How AI factories, sovereign AI, and data readiness are reshaping biopharma and accelerating scientific discovery.
body_text: America is building AI factories at industrial scale, like a modern-day version of 18th century Lancashire. That was the unmistakable takeaway from NVIDIA’s GTC DC: AI factories and “physical AI” are moving from concept to operating reality, with direct consequences for science, productivity, and national competitiveness. NVIDIA, as evidenced by its unprecedented new $5 trillion market cap, is becoming the dominant substrate of this latest industrial revolution. What is an AI factory? Typically it comprises a full‑stack, repeatable blueprint that transforms data, models, and compute into production intelligence across industries. Eli Lilly’s TuneLab supercomputer, unveiled anew at NVIDIA GTC, now spans 1,000+ Blackwell Ultra GPUs to accelerate imaging, antibody generation, and gene therapy R&D. The Department of Energy’s new Solstice system will field 100,000 Blackwell GPUs to supercharge scientific discovery at Argonne. Nokia and NVIDIA outlined an AI platform for 6G at the show that turns networks into reasoning systems, an essential backbone for robotics, smart manufacturing, and data-center integration across the economy.​ Compute is no longer the binding constraint for scientific AI; scientific data readiness is. Overlapping with the factory story was a strong policy push for sovereign AI—trusted, controllable infrastructure operated under domestic rules of the road for security, privacy, and resilience. NVIDIA’s VP/GM of Healthcare Kimberly Powell hosted a stirring conversation with U.S. Senator Todd Young of Indiana, where he laid out his agenda for a secure, domestically controlled AI infrastructure for advanced manufacturing and scientific research. With the right incentives and standards, the U.S. can maintain its resilience and competitiveness with geographic rivals. Global leadership will be earned as much in factories and foundries as in model labs, with sovereignty a design requirement rather than a bolt‑on.​ Sen. Young emphasized why Washington is now the staging ground. For biopharma leaders at GTC, the message landed with particular force. Compute is no longer the binding constraint; scientific data readiness is. Tens of exabytes of R&D data sit in proprietary formats scattered across millions of silos, impeding AI workflows and starving models of consistent signals from discovery through manufacturing. Meanwhile, Eroom’s Law continues to pressure returns, and one‑off integration projects routinely stall under complexity, timeline, and scale. (Our CEO writes about these root causes of biopharma’s productivity challenges on his Substack .) The lesson from AI factories in other verticals applies directly: value accrues to those who industrialize the data layer, productize repeatable workflows, and field teams that fuse scientific and AI capabilities in day‑to‑day operations.​​ This is the problem set TetraScience was built to solve. The Tetra Scientific Data Foundry standardizes and governs instrument and assay data as AI‑native assets—deconstructing proprietary outputs into atomic measurements and metadata mapped to shared schemas and ontologies that models can actually learn from at enterprise scope. On top of this foundation, our Scientific Use Case Factory turns those assets into packaged, repeatable workflows: a lead clone selection assistant that compresses timelines from 8 months to 2.5 months, a media optimization app that reduces wet‑lab runs by 80%, and a universal chromatography dashboard that cuts out‑of‑spec events by 75%. Sciborg teams of hybrid scientist‑engineers address these patterns in the wild by translating domain questions into data pipelines, agents, and outcomes across discovery, development, and manufacturing.​ Seen through this lens, Lilly’s TuneLab is compelling not only for GPU count but for its data posture: a platform to collaborate with biotechs under strict privacy that still allows model‑driven R&D acceleration across modalities. The DOE’s Solstice bet is similar in spirit—build the capability, then feed it with trustworthy, well‑structured scientific data to change the tempo of discovery in fields that underpin energy security and economic growth. The sovereign thread connects both: durable advantage emerges when the nation can run these cycles on infrastructure controlled for security, provenance, and policy, and when regulated sectors can adopt with confidence.​ The next phase is about sequencing. First, get the data foundation right with AI‑native standards, governance, and observability at source; second, productize high‑value scientific workflows; third, scale via agents and automation that keep humans in the loop while compounding learning across programs and plants. Do that, and AI factories become more than keynote metaphors. They become operating systems for scientific progress, and reliable engines for American productivity, resilience, and shared prosperity. Talk to us to learn about how we're partnering with NVIDIA to reimagine and replatform science for the era of AI.

title: i3 Verticals and the West Virginia Supreme Court Expand Partnership to Modernize Statewide Judicial System
summary: i3 Verticals is proud to announce a major milestone in our long-standing collaboration with the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia. Under a newly signed contract, i3 Verticals will deliver its i3 CourtOne™ Case Management Solution (CMS) to the state’s Circuit, Family, and Magistrate Courts—advancing transparency, unification, and operational efficiency across the entire judicial […]
body_text: i3 Verticals is proud to announce a major milestone in our long-standing collaboration with the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia . Under a newly signed contract, i3 Verticals will deliver its i3 CourtOne™ Case Management Solution (CMS) to the state’s Circuit, Family, and Magistrate Courts—advancing transparency, unification, and operational efficiency across the entire judicial system. This engagement marks a pivotal step in West Virginia’s modernization efforts. By implementing CourtOne™, the state will transition to a single, unified platform that simplifies case management, streamlines workflows, and enables citizens to access information with greater ease. The initiative reflects a shared vision between i3 Verticals and the West Virginia Supreme Court: to build a more connected, accessible, and cost-effective judicial experience for everyone involved. “We are thrilled to expand our partnership with the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia,” said Dave Graves, Executive Vice President, JusticeTech® . “For decades, states have attempted to unify their judicial systems in ways that resulted in high costs to their citizens. West Virginia desired something different—an innovative solution that would unify their judicial system and deliver a high-quality product to their citizens, all at a fraction of the historical net cost for these systems. We feel that our collaboration with West Virginia achieves these goals and creates a new model for the state market.” In addition to the CourtOne™ CMS, i3 Verticals will introduce a suite of value-added services designed to enhance transparency and efficiency. The expanded WVPASS platform will give citizens broader access to aggregated public court data, while Resolv 360™ , i3’s Fund Recovery Solution, will streamline financial processes and improve disposition rates across courts. Chief Justice William R. “Bill” Wooton of the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia noted, “The i3 CourtOne™ CMS will unite our Circuit, Family, and Magistrate Courts under a single, more efficient system while also promoting cost savings and increased transparency for the citizens of West Virginia.” This expanded partnership underscores i3 Verticals’ mission to empower state and local governments through innovative, cloud-native software solutions that help them serve their communities more effectively. With thousands of installations across all 50 states and Canada, i3 Verticals remains at the forefront of driving modernization across the public sector.
